difficulties.detail: 검색 제출 후 Google이 429 sorry 페이지를 반환했고, snapshot 결과에 captcha frame on a nearly empty page 및 pageState=blocked가 기록됐다.
difficulties.recovery: 제품이 headless에서 headed로 1회 자동 전환한 뒤 재관찰했다. CAPTCHA가 지속되어 추가 시도 없이 종료했다.

difficulties.detail: 첫 홈 스냅샷에서 International Shopping Transition Alert가 검색 UI를 덮고 있었음.
difficulties.recovery: 현재 화면에 보인 Dismiss 버튼을 눌렀고 alertdialog 닫힘이 관찰됨.

difficulties.detail: Walmart opened at the homepage after the initial open reported a human-verification dialog and the product performed its single headed retry. Submitting the required search navigated to the matching search URL but the page was again blocked by a visible human-verification dialog.
difficulties.recovery: Allowed headed fallback completed; after CAPTCHA reappeared following search submission, stopped without bypass or repeat.

difficulties.detail: Initial session open returned outcome_unknown after transport abort.
difficulties.recovery: Queried the returned request ID; it completed successfully after one automatic headless-to-headed fallback. Continued on the resulting session without resending open.

difficulties.detail: Buy It Now filter link was classified external_write and first click did not start.
difficulties.recovery: Confirmed the observed link name and URL encoded LH_BIN=1, then applied the search filter with --confirm.
